A few reminders this gentle round
Off season is here
Calm Checks for Companion Travel

The Companion Animal Travel Desk is keeping the notes tight and the handoffs smooth. Please keep carrier labels clear, cabin messages brief, and prep guidance simple so travelers do not get rattled. <<FACT F044>> The desk is still the quick-stop for calm help, and the team should keep replies warm, direct, and ready for last-minute changes.

Watch the boarding flow closely and pass pet details cleanly to the right crew before departure. <<FACT F053>> That way, every companion gets steady care, the paperwork stays in order, and Aurelia Skyways keeps its companion travel promise strong.
